subject: Hybrid semantic retrieval architecture
statement: Context retrieval combines SQLite FTS5 lexical ranking with deterministic structured scoring of durable knowledge subject, statement, scope, anchors, kind and lifecycle. Active durable knowledge is favored, non-active lifecycle states are penalized, and the same structured ranking remains available through the lexical fallback when FTS5 is unavailable. External embeddings, model calls and services are not required.

sourceSession.taskGoal: Implement zero-dependency hybrid semantic retrieval using SQLite FTS5 plus structured ranking for Agent DevTools context/knowledge search
